findings.problem: The explicit select adds `content: true`, which FR2.3 does not enumerate (FR2.3 lists only template.body, templateVariables, direction as additive). It is in-scope for the FR1.2/FR3.2 no-template fallback and is reflected in the client interface, so there is no leak or drift.
findings.fix: Optionally add a note in §2.1 that `content` is selected to back the FR1.2/FR3.2 no-template fallback so the enumeration delta is explicit. No logic change.

findings.problem: ISO_RE makes the zone designator mandatory (Z or ±HH:mm), so a zone-less value like 2026-10-13T12:00:00 returns 400. This satisfies FR6.5 (accepts offsets/seconds, not a round-trip) and AC13 passes, but it is a deliberate rejection worth keeping visible.
findings.fix: Keep as-is (recommended, avoids ambiguous local time), or make the zone optional with (Z|[+-]\d{2}:\d{2})? and default a missing zone to UTC if zone-less input must be tolerated. No change required.
